speaker: The Rune Door
lines: A round door of black stone, set with nine runes in three rows. As you approach they light one by one, then fade. It's waiting for you to answer.

choices.text: Trace the runes the way the Sentinel did. (Easier)

minigame.title: The Rune Door
minigame.intro: You watched the Sentinel open it. The rhythm of the runes is still fresh in your mind.

choices.text: Watch the runes and repeat the pattern.

minigame.title: The Rune Door
minigame.intro: Watch the order they light up in, then touch them in turn.
